info.title: Project & Team Management REST API
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 specification and REST API for project, team, and person management

get.description: Returns the status of database connection and aggregated counts of projects, persons, and teams.

post.summary: Initialize database and seed sample data
post.description: Creates tables in the SQLite database and seeds default test projects, teams, and persons.

get.description: Returns a list of persons with optional filtering by name/email, role, or team ID

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in name, email, and role

post.description: Creates a new person profile with optional team and project assignments

get.description: Returns details of a person including assigned team and participating projects

delete.description: Removes a person from the system

get.description: Returns a list of projects with optional search in name/description and status filtering

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query in project name or description

post.description: Creates a new project and optionally assigns initial persons and teams

get.description: Returns project details including directly assigned persons, teams, and all aggregated participants

put.description: Updates an existing project and its person/team assignments

delete.description: Deletes a project from the database

post.description: Adds a direct assignment of a person to the project

delete.description: Removes direct assignment of a person from the project

post.description: Assigns an entire team to the project (all team members become project participants)

delete.description: Removes team assignment from the project

get.description: Returns a list of all teams with optional search in name and description

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in team name and description

post.description: Creates a new team with optional initial member assignments

get.description: Returns team details including list of members and assigned projects

put.description: Updates team name, description, or member assignments

delete.description: Removes a team from the system and unlinks members and project associations
